Does anyone know why I am getting a "1.000" for my first latent variable estimate for each of my latent variables (CBI_Work, SS_CoW, Malpractice_M)? Attached is the code that I used along with the output. Also, could anyone explain the dotted line for my SEM plot for these latent variables? Thanks in advance all!

Kyle

messages.author: 17944621d521fdfa
messages.subject: Re: 1 for first variable in each latent variable
parts:
"By default, the factor loading of the first indicator of a latent variable is fixed to 1, thereby fixing the scale of the latent variable"  (The Lavaan Tutorial, p. 5). "If the argument std.lv=TRUE is used, the factor loadings of the first indicator of each latent variable will no longer be fixed to 1" (p. 12).

The marker indicator approach is the most frequently used. You should decide which observed measures will serve as marker indicator, put the best indicator of your latent factors first when forming your latent variable.
The dotted line indicates that the loading is fixed, in your case fixed to 1. 

Fran
